database.name: ARUN
database.version: Oracle Database 11g Enterprise Edition Release 11.2.0.1.0 - 64bit Production

conventions.dates: Main transaction dates are VARCHAR2(8) 'YYYYMMDD' strings (ORDERDATE, MRSDATE, ISSUEDATE, GRNDATE, ENQDATE, GIDATE, DUEDATE, RDCDATE, ADVDATE, TRANDATE). Some are NUMBER(8,0). Secondary date columns mix formats. True DATE columns are rare (SYSTEM_DATE, UPDATED_DATE, INSPECTIONDATE, ITEMSTOCK.ENTRYDATETIME, PARTYMASTER.LASTMODIFIED). NLS_DATE_FORMAT=DD-MON-RR: never compare these columns to DATE values; compare as 'YYYYMMDD' strings.
conventions.oracle_version: 11.2: no FETCH FIRST; use ROWNUM / ROW_NUMBER(); identifiers <= 30 chars.
conventions.item_key: INVITEMS.ITEM_CODE VARCHAR2(9); column is ITEM_CODE (PURCHASEORDER/MRS/ENQUIRY), CODE (GRN/ISSUE/INDENT/ADVREQUEST/NONSTOCKISSUE), ITEMCODE (ITEMSTOCK).
conventions.supplier_key: SUP_CODE -> SCM.PARTYMASTER.PARTYCODE; supplier = PARTYMASTER.GOODSTYPECODE = 2 (ERP view INVENTORY.SUPPLIER); PARTYNAME is unique.
conventions.status_columns: Numeric codes; STATUS/FLAG/POSTED are often constant 0 and meaningless. Workflow lives in APPROVALSTATUS/REJECTIONSTATUS/HOLDINGSTATUS/READYFORAPPROVAL and JMD*/SO*/IA* approval flags.
conventions.primary_keys: 574 of 696 tables have no PK; uniqueness is document number + block + serial (e.g. ORDERNO, ORDERBLOCK, SLNO, ITEM_CODE).
conventions.stock: ITEMSTOCK has one row per item per MILLCODE/HODCODE; aggregate SUM(STOCK).
conventions.archives: PY* = pre-2008 archive tables; DELETED* = deleted rows; *_UPDATE/*_CHANGES = trigger audit trails; TEMP* tables/views = per-report scratch objects.

order_pending_approval_stage.definition: PURCHASEORDER row: SO/IA/JMD all 0 -> pending at 'SO' (stores officer); SO=1,IA=0 -> 'IA' (internal audit); SO=1,IA=1,JMD=0 -> 'JMD'; all 1 -> approved.

grn_status_of_order.definition: 1 if any PURCHASEORDER line of the ORDERNO has INVQTY > 0 (something received), else 0.

total_stock.definition: SUM(ITEMSTOCK.STOCK) WHERE ITEMCODE = item AND MILLCODE = mill [AND (HODCODE = owner OR HODCODE = 1)]; NULL -> 0.

last_issue_date.definition: MAX(ISSUE.ISSUEDATE) WHERE CODE = item AND MILLCODE = mill; stored YYYYMMDD, displayed DD.MM.YYYY.

grn_rejection_reason.definition: distinct non-null GRN.REASON for the GRNNO/MILLCODE.

mrs_approval_conversion.definition: When MRS_TEMP.APPROVALSTATUS changes 0 -> 1 (and not deleted), a row is inserted into MRS (approved requisition); DUEDATE = today + DUEDAYS; an alert 'MRS NO n has been Approved' is queued.

mrs_store_rejection.definition: MRS_TEMP.STORESREJECTIONSTATUS = 1 stamps STORESREJECTEDDATETIME, sets ENQUIRYSTATUS = 0 and closes related ENQUIRY rows (CLOSESTATUS = 1).

po_net_rate.definition: PURCHASEORDER.NET / PURCHASEORDER.QTY AS NetRate; QTY is never 0 or null.

real_views.text: Select Id, MRSDate, Item_Code, Qty from MRS where UserCode = 1985 and MRSDate = 20201203

Select to_Char(MachCode) as MachineCode, MachName as MachineName, 'General' as Make, TableCode from GeneralMachine Union All Select to_Char(GensetCode) as MachineCode, to_Char(GenSetNo) as MachineName, 'General' as Make, TableCode from Maintenance.Generator Union All Select to_Char(CompressorCode) as MachineCode, to_Char(CompressorNo) as MachineName, 'General' as Make, TableCode from Maintenance.Compressor Union All Select to_Char(Mach_Code) as MachineCode, Mach_Name as MachineName, Make, TableCode from Machine Union All Select '99999' as MachineCode, 'General' as MachineName, 'General' as Make, 99999 as TableCode from Dual

(select partyname as name,partycode as ac_code, address1 as addr1,address2 as addr2,address3 as addr3,email,contperson1 as contact, offphone1 as phone,fax,website,citycode as city_code,rdcflag,statecode,GSTINID,PurMobileNo,AssetLocationFlag from scm.partymaster where goodstypecode=2 )

( select max(Id) as Id,OrderDate,Item_Code from( select Max(Purchaseorder.Id) as Id,TempPOOrder19991.OrderDate,TempPOOrder19991.Item_Code as Item_Code from PurchaseOrder Inner join TempPOOrder19991 on TempPOOrder19991.OrderDate=PurchaseOrder.OrderDate and TempPOOrder19991.Item_Code=PurchaseOrder.Item_code group by TempPOOrder19991.Orderdate,TempPOOrder19991.Item_Code) group by OrderDate,Item_Code)

( Select PurchaseOrder.OrderBlock,PurchaseOrder.OrderDate as OrderDate,PurchaseOrder.Item_Code, Supplier.Name,PurchaseOrder.Rate,PurchaseOrder.DiscPer, PurchaseOrder.CenVatPer,PurchaseOrder.TaxPer,PurchaseOrder.SurPer, PurchaseOrder.Net/PurchaseOrder.Qty as NetRate ,PurchaseOrder.Sup_Code,PurchaseOrder.ToCode,PurchaseOrder.ThroCode,PurchaseOrder.PayTerms,PurchaseOrder.OrderNo ,PurchaseOrder.PayDays,PurchaseOrder.PortCode,PurchaseOrder.State,PurchaseOrder.TaxClaimable,PurchaseOrder.Reference ,PurchaseOrder.CGst,PurchaseOrder.CGstVal,PurchaseOrder.SGst,PurchaseOrder.SGstVal,PurchaseOrder.IGst,PurchaseOrder.IGstVal ,PurchaseOrder.Cess,PurchaseOrder.CessVal From PurchaseOrder Inner Join Supplier On Supplier.Ac_Code = PurchaseOrder.Sup_Code Inner join x119991 on x119991.OrderDate= PurchaseOrder.Orderdate and x119991.Item_Code=PurchaseOrder.Item_Code and x119991.Id=PurchaseOrder.Id Where PurchaseOrder.Qty > 0 And PurchaseOrder.Net > 0)

temp_view_samples.text: (select item_code,orderdate,max(rate) as lastrate from (select item_code, orderdate,net/qty as rate from purchaseorder inner join (select item_code as code,max(orderdate) as orddate from purchaseorder where PurchaseOrder.Net> 0 And PurchaseOrder.Qty > 0 And PurchaseOrder.MillCode=0 group by item_code) on code = purchaseorder.item_code and orddate=purchaseorder.orderdate where millcode=0 and net>0 and qty>0) group by item_code,orderdate Union all select item_code,orderdate,max(rate) as lastrate from (select item_code, orderdate,net/qty as rate from PYOrder inner join (select item_code as code,max(orderdate) as orddate from PYOrder where PYOrder.Net> 0 And PYOrder.Qty > 0 And PYOrder.MillCode=0 group by item_code) on code = PYOrder.item_code and orddate = PYOrder.orderdate where millcode=0 and net>0 and qty>0) group by item_code,orderdate)

(select item_code,orderdate,max(rate) as lastrate from (select item_code, orderdate,net/qty as rate from purchaseorder inner join (select item_code as code,max(orderdate) as orddate from purchaseorder where PurchaseOrder.Net> 0 And PurchaseOrder.Qty > 0 And PurchaseOrder.MillCode=0 group by item_code) on code = purchaseorder.item_code and orddate=purchaseorder.orderdate where millcode=0 and net>0 and qty>0) group by item_code,orderdate Union all select item_code,orderdate,max(rate) as lastrate from (select item_code, orderdate,net/qty as rate from PYOrder inner join (select item_code as code,max(orderdate) as orddate from PYOrder where PYOrder.Net> 0 And PYOrder.Qty > 0 And PYOrder.MillCode=0 group by item_code) on code = PYOrder.item_code and orddate = PYOrder.orderdate where millcode=0 and net>0 and qty>0) group by item_code,orderdate)
